subject: Using Rhipe with Hadoop On Demand

messages.author: 6e6add00a182d10e
messages.subject: Using Rhipe with Hadoop On Demand
parts: Is it possible to use Rhipe with Hadoop On Demand (HOD)?  Can I use the path= parameter to point to the cluster directory created by the HOD allocation?  I am trying to test this but I have to wait a long time in the scheduler queue before my Hadoop cluster becomes available .  Thanks for any comments.

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Using Rhipe with Hadoop On Demand
parts:
rhinit starts a Java server (which communicates between R and Hadoop)
on the *client* end. It expects a preexisting Hadoop installation.
you could try rhinit(buglevel = 2000)

I've never used HOD, my experience is zero at best.
